title: Analytic Continuation of Conformal Integrals in Momentum Space
summary: Conformal symmetry strongly constrains correlation functions. In momentum space, the conformal Ward identities are solved for three-point functions by integrals of a product of three Bessel functions ("triple-$K$ integrals"); more generally, integrals of this type ("multiple-$K$ integrals"), serve as the building blocks of a wide class of higher-point conformal correlators. These integrals belong to the class of generalised hypergeometric functions, and while their series representations are known in principle, none converges throughout the entire physical region of kinematic space selected…
